candidates.duplicate_check_note: Exact event_id, source URL/record ID, DOB NOW job/permit/tracking identifiers, source-date tokens, and title/date/site keys were screened against the manual corpus plus NYC DOB NOW/DOB permit/DOB CO candidate packs through Round531.

permit.work_on_floor: Floor Number(s) 1, Floor Number(s) 1, Floor Number(s) 2, Floor Number(s) 3
permit.job_description: APPLICATION FILED TO ENLARGE THE EXISTING SECOND FLOOR AND TO ADD  A NEW PARTIAL THIRD STORY ADDITION INCLUDING MISC. WORK AS INDICATED ON PLANS SUBMITTED HEREWITH.
